title: GET <hosts.<name>.url with its last path segment replaced by `metrics`> — `beacon serve`'s host metrics (version 1)
$comment: Columns, not rows: every array has exactly one entry per entry of `t` (a rule this schema cannot express; the CLI's golden test checks it). A scalar is the latest reading. `null` is a reading that failed or does not exist yet. The body bytes change once per sample, so ETag/304 hold in between (ADR D4, D10). The CLI writes exactly this; the app ignores unknown fields (ADR D1).

every_s.description: Seconds between samples: 60. A wider step between two entries of `t` is a gap (serve was not running, or the host slept).

t.description: When each sample was taken: Unix seconds, UTC, oldest first. Empty until the first sample.

load1.description: Load average over 1 min, two decimals.

cpu_pct.description: Mean busy share of all cores since the previous sample, 0–100, one decimal. Null on the first sample after a start.

mem.description: Physical memory. Used is what cannot be given back without swapping: it excludes file cache.

disks.description: Keyed by mount point, one key per entry of hosts.<name>.disks in the config serve runs now.

used_bytes.description: Size minus free: everything not available on the volume's disk.

total_bytes.description: The latest reading; null until one succeeds.
